steps.label: Hochladen
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && ls -la peloton_film6c.mp4 && tar xzf th6.tgz && curl -sS --fail -m 120 -X PUT -H 'Content-Type: image/jpeg' -H 'If-None-Match: *' --data-binary @thumb_a.jpg "$(tr -d '\n' < ups_t.txt)" && curl -sS --fail -m 2000 -T peloton_film6c.mp4 -H 'Content-Type: video/mp4' -H 'If-None-Match: *' "$(tr -d '\n' < ups_v.txt)" && rm -f ups_t.txt ups_v.txt && echo UPLOAD_OK
